# Commodity swap (`cmd-swap` v1)

Fixed price against the average of a floating index.

**Asset class:** Commodity · **Family:** swap · **Product type:** `CMD_SWAP`

Applies to trades whose `productType` is `CMD_SWAP`. Open one with `TRD <tradeId>`.

```sutra
sutra: cmd-swap
version: 1
description: Fixed price against the average of a floating index.
match: { kind: trade, where: "$.productType == 'CMD_SWAP'", priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Commodity · Commodity swap, id: $.tradeId, with: "link($.counterparty.id, 'counterparty', $.counterparty.name)" }
strip:
  - { label: Notional, bind: "$.currency + ' ' + fmt($.notional, 'amount0')" }
  - { label: Direction, bind: $.direction }
  - { label: Trade date, bind: $.tradeDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturityDate, fmt: date }
  - { label: MTM (USD), bind: $.mtm, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Delta (USD), bind: $.risk.delta, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
  - { label: Book, bind: "link($.book, 'book')" }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    code: TRM
    key: F2
    columns:
      - { label: Fixed price, bind: $.terms.fixedPrice, fmt: price2 }
      - { label: Quantity per period, bind: $.terms.quantityPerPeriod, fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Averaging, bind: $.terms.averaging }
      - { label: Effective, bind: $.effectiveDate, fmt: date }
      - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterparty.name }
  - id: legs
    kind: tabs
    title: Legs
    each: $.legs
    layout: columns
    tabTitle: "'Leg ' + @.leg + ' · ' + @.label"
    body:
      kind: kv
      columns:
        - { label: Pay/receive, bind: "@.payReceive" }
        - { label: Rate type, bind: "@.rateType" }
        - { label: Index, bind: "@.index" }
        - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
        - { label: Spread, bind: "@.spread", fmt: bp1 }
        - { label: Frequency, bind: "@.frequency" }
        - { label: Day count, bind: "@.dayCount" }
        - { label: Currency, bind: "@.currency" }
        - { label: Notional, bind: "@.notional", fmt: amount0 }
  - id: schedule
    kind: table
    title: Fixings
    code: FIX
    key: F3
    rows: $.schedule
    columns:
      - { label: Fixing date, bind: "@.fixingDate", fmt: date }
      - { label: Period, bind: "@.period" }
      - { label: Index, bind: "@.index" }
      - { label: Rate, bind: "@.rate", fmt: pct4 }
      - { label: Payoff, bind: "@.payoff", fmt: signed0, tone: sign, total: true }
      - { label: Status, bind: "@.status", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - id: marketData
    kind: line
    title: "Commodity forward curve: Forward curve"
    code: CMDC
    key: F4
    area: right
    source: "link($.commodityCurve, 'commodity-curve')"
    rows: points
    x: month
    y: price
    fmt: price2
  - id: sensitivities
    kind: hbar
    title: Delta by bucket (USD)
    code: SENS
    area: right
    rows: $.sensitivities
    label: bucket
    value: delta
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - id: pnl
    kind: line
    title: Daily P&L, last 20 days (USD)
    code: PNL
    area: right
    rows: $.pnlHistory
    x: date
    y: pnl
    fmt: signed0
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.nettingSet, 'netting-set')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

## Terms

Product-specific terms live under `terms` in the trade document.

| Field | Label | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `terms.fixedPrice` | Fixed price | `price2` |
| `terms.quantityPerPeriod` | Quantity per period | `amount0` |
| `terms.averaging` | Averaging | text |

## Market data

Reference fields on the trade point at the market data it is valued with. They show under *Linked entities* and drive F8 impact ("which trades use this curve?").

| Field | Kind | Selected by |
|---|---|---|
| `commodityCurve` | `commodity-curve` (Commodity forward curve) | `{commodity}` |
| `discountCurve` | `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve) | `ois:{ccy}` |

## Risk

| Measure | Field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Delta | `risk.delta` | value change per unit move in the underlier |

The *Delta by bucket* chart reads `sensitivities[].delta`.

## Legs

2 legs under `legs`, shown side by side: pay/receive, rate type, index, rate, spread, frequency, day count, currency, notional.

## Fixings

`schedule` rows (table), F3: `fixingDate`, `period`, `index`, `rate`, `payoff`, `status`.

## Layout notes

- The strip leads with size and dates, then MTM (emphasised) and the product's main risk measures.
- F2 is the terms, F3 the schedule, F4 the market data it is most sensitive to; F7 opens the netting set, F8 shows impact and F9 the raw document.
- Common fields (counterparty, netting set, book, trader, MTM, P&L) are described in the pack guide.
